name: Luce Aurea
source:
A student from the "other side" Ciarán meets by chance. Her role in the weird emails Ciarán receives is unknown, although she seems to be related somehow.

Luce is strong, direct, and energetic. She plays sports and loves to draw. She has a weird way of laughing that not everybody has heard, especially since she uses a façade in front of other people and pretends to be an average high schooler. She lies about stuff Ciarán doesn't get why anyone would lie about. Loves justice, and always justifies everything in the name of it.
